capability lives in the outermost of four places that can hold it: a definition when it only routes or instructs; a module when it is code that needs a domain\\u0027s nouns to describe or acts on a system outside Coanda\\u0027s record; the engine only when it passes both the noun test (it can be specified in naming.md\\u0027s engine vocabulary alone) and the need test (a guarantee of the record depends on it, or it needs a power the design withholds from modules); and, inside the engine, the core for record shapes and pure rules, the daemon for anything that reads or writes. A domain noun in the engine is allowed only as a recorded exception naming the decision that allows it and the condition that ends it.
